what: A paid Chrome extension called "Patreon Scraper" offers features for scraping Patreon data at $18.99/month, including scraping search results, comments, and membership tiers with export to CSV, JSON, XLSX.
verbatim_snippet: "🅿️ Patreon Scraper features ✓ No password, API login or permissions required ✓ Runs in the background; switch tabs with ease ✓ Simple and easy to use ✓ 24/7 developer support 🤔 How to use the Patreon Scraper Extension? Visit a user's Patreon, scroll down, click on 'See all x posts' or visit patreon.com/user/posts then open the extension, set your limit or how many items you wish to scrape, then click on the 'Scrape' button to start scraping. ⚠️ Important For the extension to work, make sure your Patreon web language is set to English. 💳 Pricing, Return and Refund Policy ● Access all features for just $18.99/month. No account required to sign up, and you can cancel at any time, no questions asked!"
